about:
Steel Queen operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, as a 100% woman-owned, second-generation business with over 30 years of experience in designing and manufacturing sheet metal products. The company specializes in stainless steel fabrication with an emphasis on commercial kitchen equipment.

Its capabilities span custom sheet metal fabrication, including punching, brake forming, roll forming, TIG welding, polishing, finishing, CAD design, on-site modifications, installations, plasma cutting, and drilling/studding. The shop produces items such as countertops, equipment stands, counterlines, cabinets, dish tables, drain pans, shelving, and store-front brake metal, working with materials that include aluminum (painted, anodized, mill), stainless steel (T304, #4 and #8 finishes), brass, copper, carbon steel, galvanized steel, galvannealed steel, and expanded metal.

Steel Queen serves a diverse client base across restaurants, hospitals, automotive and lube industries, architects, contractors, fence and sign companies, artisans, interior designers, glass and storefront companies, prisons, museums, schools and colleges, churches, and aerospace organizations.

The company cites its commitment to the "Golden Rule" of service, a licensed mechanical contractor on staff, and being fully licensed, bonded, and insured as key differentiators. It also highlights quick turnaround times and competitive pricing as factors that keep projects on schedule.
